Name: (CP) Friendable Mr.Qi
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[center][size=6][img]https://i.imgur.com/abNU0MH.gif[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/ozdixq6.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/abNU0MH.gif[/img] 
[/size][/center][i][center]Ever since I started playing Stardew Valley in 2018, and discovered Mr.Qi, I've wanted him to be an NPC. He's genuinely my favorite character in the game despite the minimal content. And since I started modding in 2022 I realized that I could, in fact, make that dream a reality. And so I did! Now you too can actually interact with the blue man!

[size=1]PSA: I only realized that someone ALSO made a Mr.Qi mod about 75% of the way through development of this one... honestly that didn't deter me from making this in the slightest. I only know the other mod exists, I haven't looked at it yet aside from being told and confirming it's a thing. You can check it out [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16724][size=1]Here

[/size][/url][i][b]When reporting bugs PLEASE include a [url=http://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]﻿ and a description of what's wrong. Just saying "it's not working" isn't going to help me fix it!
[/b][/i]﻿[/center][/i] [left][img]https://i.imgur.com/Wxu8uY6.png[/img][/left][left][i]This mod adds a lot of stuff. It honestly might be more accurate to call it "Mr.Qi Expansion" or something like that, but honestly I chose the name at the start, and it's a teensy bit too late to change that now.[/i][/left]
What it adds:
[list]
[*]One (1) Mr.Qi NPC (that you can marry!)
[*]28 Heart Events - Plus 1 Heart Event with SVE, and one with a certain skull cavern mod :)
[*]4 Repeatable dates if you marry him
[*]Alternate versions of every heart event 6 hearts and up based on being in a relationship with Qi
[*]Responses/reactions to player death if you're married
[*]Custom children sprites (and an option for some RAD children)
[*]Over 1000+ Dialogue Lines (In part thanks to [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jazzybees?gameId=1303]Jazzybee[/url]﻿ <3) (I honestly don't even know how many he has now)
[*]4 New Cooking Recipes/14 with the Arena enabled
[*]2 New Crafting Recipes/7 with the Arena enabled (and 8 with Spacecore and the Arena)
[*]3 New Crops
[*]A new Scarecrow
[*]8 new (ish) pet options
[*]A new set of end game weapons
[*]A 'new' item :)
[*]10 New Quests
[*]6 New Special Orders (3 are repeatable)
[*]3 New Locations/8 with the Arena enabled
[*]A new (small) shop/Two shops with the Arena Enabled
[*]A bunch of new monster textures with the Arena Enabled
[*]Extensive Configuration Options
[/list]What it does not add/do:[list]
[*]Make Mr.Qi a redeemable person
[*]Add the cure for depression
[/list]
[b]Side Note: I mention this later but Qi will spawn the day AFTER you go into the Casino for the first time!
[/b]

[size=3][u]Arena Info:[/u][/size]
[spoiler]
The Arena itself is relatively complex and has many parts! So here we go! 

[b][i]Note:[/i][/b] This area is meant to be END GAME content. It's supposed to be hard, you are supposed to get your socks rocked. That is the purpose, and that's also why the general unlock is set to so late in the game. Go prepared, or be pepared to get thrown into a wall, I guess. If you don't like the Arena content there is a config to toggle it :)

The arena shop unlocks in a tiered way, the more monsters you kill the more stuff is available. If you don't like this, use the 'Arena Difficulty' config option and set it to 'None' - then you don't have to worry about any of that :)


[b]Initial Unlock [Regular]:[/b]
[list]
[*]8 Hearts with Mr.Qi
[*]Complete either the Hardmode Mines or Skull Caverns Special Orders on Ginger Island
[*]Complete 'Qi's Hungry Challenge' Special Order on Ginger Island
[*]Have earned 1 million g
[*]Have a combat level of 8
[*]Have shipped 10 Ancient Cacti
[/list][b]Initial Unlock [Easy]:[/b]
[list]
[*]8 Hearts with Mr.Qi
[*]Complete either the Hardmode Mines or Skull Caverns Special Orders on Ginger Island
[*]Have a combat level of 5
[*]Have shipped 10 Ancient Cacti
[/list]
After completing the previously mentioned requirements you will recieve a letter in the mail asking you to meet Mr.Qi in his room. There, an event will play explaining the arena. If you want spoilers about how it works and such:
[spoiler]
[i]The arena itself changes seasonally, and has seasonal monsters and forage. Most monsters have custom drops, and all objects and forage can be turned into something useful. There will be an obelisk added to the wizard's shop for you to purchase, and for those of you who can/are using Spacecore you can also buy a warp totem recipe from the Arena itself (shop explained later) or warp totems from the Casino.[/i]
[/spoiler]

[u][size=3][b]Integrated/Compatible:
[/b][/size][/u][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/url]﻿ All Festivals were tested to make sure they had compatibility with SVE locations and NPCs. In addition, there are alternate schedules and events that go based off of SVE's maps. I also added events that are specifically SVE adjacent to the game, and dialogue that relates to ... certain events that happen in SVE.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village:[/url]﻿ Should be no conflicts - I made sure to modify his Festival positions if the mod is included. He also shows up at both ridgeside festivals!

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp:[/url]﻿ Friendable Mr.Qi also provides patches for the vanilla NPC's textures so he should look sparkly in all events that reference him... even if they seem a bit out of character (or maybe its in character to you who knows) 

[b]Other expansion/NPC mods:[/b] I also did basic testing with most expansions, should be compatible - his festival positions are out of the way and I moved them if I saw he overlapped with an NPC.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPCMapLocations:[/url]﻿ His sprite should show up on the map!

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats:[/url]﻿ I added warps to his room, his office, his arena, and to outside his Walnut Room for those who want ez pz access.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31247]Rokugin's Exclusions:[/url]﻿ Makes it so Cooking and crafting recipes don't count towards perfection!

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore:[/url]﻿ Adds descriptions to the furniture items, a ring, and a warp totem.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker:[/url] Adds an Indigo themed Trinket to the game!

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31550]Anime Portraits for Mr.Qi:[/url] CapMita has created absolutely spectacular portraits for this mod! :D 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34261]Ohodavi's Portraits for Ms. Qi[/url]: Starlight has created beautiful alternative portraits for this mod for Ms.Qi! 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia:[/url] Nomori oh so graciously added compatibility for their lovely witch! Now Qi can have magic beef with her too! 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100]Seven Deadly Sins:[/url] Alternate versions of events have been provided when SDS is installed so that everything works on their new maps.

[size=3][u][b]Incompatible:[/b][/u][/size]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12422]
Mr.Qi Dialogue Expansion:[/url]﻿ Not compatible as the default Qi Npc Is rendered invisible and moved, however I got permission from Jaz to include as much of the dialogue within my mod as I want as well as to use it as inspiration - so the mod is essentially built in (thank you Jaz! <3) 

[b]Qi Portraits:[/b] NOT compatible with many that presently exist, this mod adds 13 new portrait expressions for Mr.Qi (as well as two that aren't him but are used for something else) and therefore other portraits will not work. If you have portrait mods that change him you will have to disable them.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4310]Mx.Qi:[/url]﻿ Due to some of the config options I have for my mod, you get to choose what honorific Qi goes by. As such, my mod edits all references to Mr. Qi to follow whatever you select it to be. This means it probably edits the stuff that this mod edits - so it will not be compatible nor will you need it - my mod [i]also[/i] edits those areas to make sure he does not call you 'kid' if you choose to switch that too. 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25567]Craftable Qi Seasoning:[/url]﻿ This is a mod that I made that is now integrated within Friendable Mr.Qi - do not install both, you dont need them and i have no clue what that would do or if it would break anything. This also applies for any other mods that add a recipe for the seasoning.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16724]Mister Qi Is A Real NPC:[/url] Honestly I have no clue if this is compatible, I don't know how they edit Mr.Qi or turn him into an NPC, but the likilhood is that it's not, so don't install them both.﻿

[b]Any mod that adds Craftable Auto-Petters: [/b]Technically they might work if they name the recipe something else, but for the most part avoid those as well.

[b]Misc: [/b]Any other mods that edit the right side of the casino
Any mod that edits the Walnut Room... I couldn't find one but if it does it won't work with mine. I can add compatibility if they're brought to my attention :)

Recolor mods will technically work but I have some custom tilesheets so a fair few thing will look weird, it is possible for mod authors to target these assets to recolor them as well for recolor compatibility, but I do NOT have the time or patience for that B')

[i]Other than that it should not conflict with anything else but if you find anything let me know :)[/i]

[spoiler][u][size=3]Perfection and Achievement Section:[/size][/u]

[b]Include Monoculture Crops:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the crops count towards the Monoculture achievement
[b]Include Polyculture Crops:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the crops count towards the Polyculture achievement
[b]Exclude Arena Legendary Fish:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the Legendary Fish in Qi's Arena counts towards the fishing collection

[u][size=3]Qi Edits Section:[/size][/u]
[b]Qi Farmer Reference:[/b] Kid/Farmer/@ (looks like an arrow, this just means your name) - Changes what Qi refers to you as in his dialogue
[b]Qi Gender:[/b] Male/Female/Undefined/Random - Changes the internal gender of Qi,the honorific Qi uses (Mr. Mx. Ms.), how you have children with them, their sprites/portraits, and a variety of other things
[b]Qi Farmer Endearment Reference:[/b] What endearment term Qi uses for you when you're dating/married  - default is 'My Star'
[b]Qi Child Adoption:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the farmer and Qi can have children or only adopt them
[b]Qi Child Question:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not Qi will ask for children/wants children
[b]Qi Children Sprites:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the children will use custom sprites to look like Qi (They're blue)
[b]Radical Qi Children:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the children you have with Qi will have sunglasses (RADICAL!)
[b]Qi Date Chance:[/b] [0-100] - Sets the chance for one of the repeatable dates with Qi to happen
[b]Simple Qi Schedule:[/b] True/False - Switches between Qi's default, more complex schedule, and a simpler one
[b]Nyapu Style Qi Portraits:[/b] True/False - Toggles Nyapu style Qi portraits

[b]Blue Mania Special Order:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the Blue Mania Special Order repeats
[b]Descent Into The Depths:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the Descent Into The Depths Special Order repeats
[b]Descent Into The Depths Level:[/b] [Number] - Sets what level Qi challenges you to get down to for the DITD Special Order
[b]Very Hungry Challenge:[/b] Toggles whether or not the Very Hungry Challenge Special Order repeats
[b]Very Hungry Challenge Level:[/b] [Number] - Sets what level Qi challenges you to get down to for the VHC Special Order
[b]Skull Cavern Monster Eradication:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the Skull Cavern Monster Eradication Special Order repeats
[b]Skull Cavern Monster Amount:[/b] [Number] - Sets how many Skull Caverns monsters Qi will request for you to kill for the SCME Special Order
[b]Volcano Monster Eradication:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the Volcano Monster Eradication Special Order repeats
[b]Volcano Monster Amount:[/b] [Number] - Sets how many volcano monsters Qi will request for you to kill for the VME Special Order
[b]Easy Quests:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not you want Qi's mailed quests to be easier or not

[b]Amount of Truffle Oil:[/b] [Number] - Sets the amount of truffle oil to be used in the Qi Seasoning Recipe

[b]Amount of Cloth:[/b] [Number] - Sets the amount of cloth to be used in the Auto-Petter Recipe

[b][u]Known Bugs + Bug Reporting:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]If you cheat into Qi's Walnut Room you will not be able to purchase the Gem Weapons... don't cheat, Qi is watching
[*]On the first day of unlocking the Casino, if you try to click on his door it'll spam red into your SMAPI Console. This is technically because he doesn't exist yet, and will go away on day 2 (I could not, for the life of me, fix this)
[*]Qi will still kill you if you cheat onto the Summit while married or dating... I can't fix this, and even if I could I wouldn't because it's kinda funny and also, don't cheat
[*]Qi's dialogue in other mods will be funky fresh and will not match up.
[*]Without Spacecore there is a high likelihood that NPCs will do weird pathing into Qi's room and get stuck there. I cannot fix this, it's just the way that Stardew is. Very weird, not cool.
[/list]
[i][b]Again, when reporting bugs PLEASE include a SMAPI log and a description of what's wrong. Just saying "it's not working" isn't going to help me fix it! There is no feasible way I can test everything in this mod or every dialogue line so I'm sure some of it's broken, I'll fix it ASAP when bugs are noticed.
[/b][/i]
